items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Kenneth Pitts and stayed in Fort Worth. And now this was with, with the Doe Boys... Those two were going to school at TCU studying.

ctx.x: Kenneth Pitts and Cecil Brower. Cecil Brower is now in Nashville the leading, oh, hillbilly violinist, I suppose, of the whole country now. He's on most of the records than anybody at all. Cecil Brower.
